# Per-package statement coverage floors for scripts/coverage-gate.sh.
#
# Every package returned by `go list ./internal/...` is measured against its
# entry here, or against `default` when it has no entry. A package that exists
# but has no tests is measured at 0% and therefore fails the gate; add the
# package explicitly when it first needs a lower floor.
#
# Floors are percentages of statement coverage in the unit profile
# (`coverage.out`) and must stay at or below the measured value on `main`.
# Raise a floor when coverage improves; lower one deliberately, in the same
# pull request, with a comment explaining why. `CONTRIBUTING.md` describes the
# procedure.
#
# Format: <package> <percent>
default 70

internal/acctest 85
internal/datasources/catalogs 74
internal/datasources/roles 74
internal/datasources/schemas 74
internal/datasources/tableprivileges 71
internal/provider 88
internal/providerdata 100
internal/resources/catalog 74
internal/resources/grantprivileges 75
internal/resources/grantrole 66
internal/resources/materializedview 85
internal/resources/role 68
internal/resources/schema 82
internal/resourceutil 95
internal/trino 87
internal/trinotest 85
